decision_cruda.rationale: Radio (LH-01 hydraulic failure at N600-09, stopped) and CMMS OT-5100 (hydraulic, open, 3-5 h on site) agree, so CONFIRM-01 is not triggered. Repair finishes about 12:20-14:20 at the earliest, so N600-09 would lose most of its remaining shift. It holds 243 t of broken ore at 11.9 g/t, or about 0.38 oz/t. The Norte level stockpile is at 238/450 t, so it has room. Norte has 3 trucks and about 66 t/h of haul capacity (0.227 factor). Stockpiled ore counts at 17:00, so extra mucking adds value until the stockpile is full. Candidate lenders must be a loading stope or a development heading (LOADER-SOURCE-01). LH-08 on DS-C538-01 is the cheapest, at 0.2 oz/h versus 4.0 oz/h for the critical-path DS-E543-02. Moving a loader from a producing stope would cost more. The trip is about 0.7 h (via the surface road and the Norte ramp). That leaves about 6 h of mucking at an LH410 rate of 30×100/(100+0.15×120) = 25.4 t/h, or about 152 t, which is about 58 oz. The stockpile reaches roughly 270-300 t, so it does not hit the 450 t cap. Cost is about 0.2×6.7 h ≈ 1.3 oz of development value, plus a little for the 0.7 h travel. Net is about 55 oz. No reserve is activated, because no stope is stopped (RESERVE-01). RETURN-01 is left to the layer.
